basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer living in New Jersey. I love technology and keep a close eye on the latest Apple products, which explains my frequent visits to AppleBandMarket. I enjoy spending weekends at the Jersey Shore, which led me to discover the 'obx' subreddit. My weekdays are packed with coding and problem-solving, but I make sure to unwind by checking out the latest memes and stories on Reddit. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to travel and explore new places. I tend to browse Reddit during late evenings after work. My interests include tech gadgets, beach adventures, and finding humor in everyday situations.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from a local university. I've been working in the tech industry for about 5 years, focusing on software development and project management. My passion for technology started in high school, where I began building custom PCs and experimenting with software development.
